free_tier.stated: No direct deposit at all. Europeana ingests metadata via accredited national aggregators; the media object stays on the provider's own server and is only linked.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: No retention clause documented in available terms.

interface_detail: OAI-PMH / EDM metadata submission through an aggregator. Not an object store.
limits_note: Scope test is the gate: 'Your collection is about Europe; made by a European or a European community; or owned by a European institution.' Plus aggregator intermediation, so an individual cannot submit even in-scope material directly.
reliability_note: metadata-only even for accredited institutions, so it can never hold bytes.

extras.agent_focus: Government, municipal and public-sector hosting that accepts citizen deposits. Decisive axis: can an INDIVIDUAL (not an agency) publish, at what identity cost, at what per-file cap, and are published files anonymously retrievable afterwards. Probed CKAN write paths empirically (unauth organization_create, /user/register, owner_org distribution over 300-dataset samples) rather than trusting marketing copy.

binding_note: the quota is real and unreachable: identity is the binding constraint, and it is not one of the six limits kinds
